text: Gold closed about 0.5% higher at roughly $4,017, holding just above $4,000 after a brief dip at the New York open.
Silver ended nearly flat near $54, so the gold/silver ratio edged up to about 74.4.
Gold miners did a little better than gold: GDX rose about 1% to $81.02 and GDXJ about 0.6%.
Stocks bounced, led by chip and AI shares after Anthropic's IPO filing: the Nasdaq rose 0.8%, the S&P 500 0.7% and TQQQ about 3.2%.
Brent settled down about 0.8% at $115.81 on Middle East peace hopes, still far above $100.
The VIX fear gauge fell about 5% to 18.4 as oil eased and stocks recovered.
Bitcoin slipped just below $80,000 as traders stayed cautious ahead of the Fed.
